custom_fields.label: Quoted By Agent
custom_fields.description: Seller agent handle (e.g. jupiterSellerAgent). Source: agent card.

custom_fields.label: Quoted By OOR
custom_fields.description: Seller OOR holder (e.g. Jupiter_Chief_Sales_Officer). Source: agent card vLEImetadata.oorHolderName.

custom_fields.label: Seller LEI
custom_fields.description: GLEIF LEI of the selling entity. Source: agent card.

custom_fields.label: Seller Agent AID
custom_fields.description: KERI agent AID. Source: agent card keriIdentifiers.agentAID.

custom_fields.label: Seller OOR AID
custom_fields.description: KERI OOR holder AID. Source: agent card keriIdentifiers.oorHolderAID.

custom_fields.label: Quote Revision
custom_fields.description: Friendly counter R1/R2/R3 parallel to native amended_from chain. Source: saga round.

custom_fields.label: Quoted At
custom_fields.description: Agent-stamped ISO issue time. Source: orchestrator.

custom_fields.label: Credential Mode
custom_fields.description: plain for P01-P10; vlei from ITER7. Source: flag CREDENTIAL_MODE.

custom_fields.label: Signed Envelope Hash
custom_fields.description: sha256 envelope hash of the issued quote (joins T5 audit). Source: PlainHashSigner.

custom_fields.label: ACTUS Sim ID
custom_fields.description: ACTUS PAM sim id behind the price. Source: treasury consult (P02, P05, P07, P08, P10).
